overall: The AG found the Zoning Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law: the livestream was inadvertently mislabeled as a Licensing Board meeting, with no evidence of intent to hide it. The AG only reminded members to file certification forms and ordered no remedy.

allegations.summary: June 7 livestream on Facebook was labeled as an Everett Licensing Board meeting, allegedly intentionally to mislead the public about a property the chair owned.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law does not speak to the labeling of meetings as they are livestreamed to the public or recordings of meetings posted online after the fact, nor is there any evidence that the Board acted to hide its June 7 meeting from the public.

allegations.summary: Complaint suggested Board members may not have filed the required Open Meeting Law certification within two weeks of taking office.
allegations.key_passage: If members of the Board have not yet completed the required Open Meeting Law certification form, they should do so immediately.
